description: Capture a UI Toolkit element and compare the cropped image against a reference image.

gameObjectPath.description: Scene GameObject path that owns the UIDocument.

gameObjectName.description: Scene GameObject name that owns the UIDocument.

includeInactive.description: Include inactive scene UIDocuments. Defaults to true.

runtime.description: Capture a runtime UIDocument element when true; otherwise capture an EditorWindow UI Toolkit element. Defaults to false.

window.description: EditorWindow type/title to capture. Runtime defaults to Game.

name.description: VisualElement.name exact match if path is omitted.

className.description: USS class name exact match if path is omitted.

typeName.description: VisualElement type name contains match if path is omitted.

actualPath.description: Output path for captured current element PNG.

diffOutputPath.description: Optional output path for diff PNG.

referenceRect.description: Optional comparison rect in reference image.

actualRect.description: Optional comparison rect in captured image.

tolerance.description: Allowed per-channel pixel delta. Defaults to 0.

padding.description: Extra capture padding in pixels. Defaults to 0.

effectiveOpacity.description: Product of the element's and its current hierarchy ancestors' native resolved opacity values. This excludes texture alpha, tint, visibility and clipping.
